summary: Frontend testing completed for student notes blog system redesign. All requested features verified working: dark theme, responsive design, comments, share buttons, admin CRUD operations.
critical_code_review_comments: Notes.js: Dark navy theme (#0a1628) with proper contrast - text is readable
NoteDetail.js: .note-article-content CSS class properly styles code blocks, tables, headings with dark backgrounds
DataContext.js: deleteItem/updateItem gracefully handle Firestore errors for mock data with try-catch and local state updates
AdminNotes.js: Image/video toolbar handlers use URL prompts (insertImageByURL, insertVideoByURL) instead of file upload
Mobile responsive: Single column grid layout at 375px width with 'Filter by Subject' toggle button
seed_data_creation: Mock data from DataContext.js (3 notes: note-1, note-2, note-3) used when Firestore collection is empty
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend features verified working. Dark theme redesign complete. Comments section functional (stores in Firestore 'comments' collection). Share buttons (WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter, Copy Link) working. Admin can delete mock notes (shows success toast, updates local state, but mock data reappears on refresh as expected). Mobile responsive at 375px with single column layout.
